设计意图： The smoothed drawdown-recovery mechanism remains primary, preserving a persistent recovery signal while using a bounded volume-pressure attenuation. Recovery is modestly downweighted when returns and changing volume show aligned participation pressure, reducing sensitivity to abrupt volume shocks without introducing a separate alpha source. 因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-([ewm_mean(4, close / lagged 15-bar low - 1) - 0.5 drawdown_depth] × [0.75 + 0.75 drawdown_depth] × [1 - 0.2 tanh(Corr20(return, Δlog(volume)))])
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
drawdown_depth回撤深度距前期高点的回撤幅度

算子

算子含义
ewm_meanewm_mean(x, span=n) → 指数加权移动平均 (EMA；span 控制衰减速度)
tanhtanh(x) → 双曲正切，将值压到 (-1, 1)
Corr20Corr20(x, y) → 20 日相关

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
tanh计算双曲正切值
ts_deltan 期差分：x − x_shift(n)
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 volume：volume
  4. 计算 prior_peak：close.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5)
  5. 计算 drawdown_depth：(1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8)
  6. 计算 prior_low：low.滚动窗口(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1)
  7. 计算 recovery：close / prior_low - 1.0
  8. 计算 recovery_score：recovery.ewm(span=4, adjust=False, min_periods=4).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth
  9. 计算 log_volume：np.log(volume.clip(lower=1.0))
  10. 计算 safe_close：close
  11. 计算 volume_pressure：returns.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).corr(log_volume.diff())
  12. 计算 confirmation_weight：1.0 - 0.2 * np.tanh(volume_pressure)
  13. 计算 factor：recovery_score * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) * confirmation_weight
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

列名含义说明

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. MA4(close / lagged 15-bar low - 1) — MA4(close / lagged 15-bar low - 1) — 用户自定义算子
  2. log(volume) — log(x) → 自然对数

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized(df): """Measure persistent recovery ">class="kw">from a prior drawdown with bounded volume-pressure attenuation.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] low = df_copy["low"] volume = df_copy["volume"] prior_peak = close.rolling(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5).replace(0.0, np.nan) drawdown_depth = (1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8) prior_low = low.rolling(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan) recovery = close / prior_low - 1.0 recovery_score = recovery.ewm(span=4, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=4).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth log_volume = np.log(volume.clip(lower=1.0)) safe_close = close.replace(0.0, np.nan) returns = safe_close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) volume_pressure = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(log_volume.diff()).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0) confirmation_weight = 1.0 - 0.2 * np.tanh(volume_pressure) factor = recovery_score * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) * confirmation_weight df_copy["factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized"]
